messages.subject: Non-separable space-time Matern fields
parts:
The paper describing the new class of non-separable space-time Matern fields is
now available at

https://www.idescat.cat/sort/sort481/48.1.1.Lindgren-etal.pdf

the R-package that goes along is 'INLAspacetime', which is on CRAN, is required
to use these models. The INLAspacetime adds these models to R-INLA.
